name: List
summary: Vertical sequence primitive — semantic <ul>/<ol> with Lumen chrome. Three flavors: plain (text bullets / numbered), structured (each row is a ListItem with leading/trailing slots, the Apple Settings / iOS-style listview), and interactive (each row navigates or actions, with hover + focus chrome). Pairs with Divider for inset separators; with Skeleton[shape='row'] for loading state.

kind.description: Semantic list type. unordered = <ul>, ordered = <ol>, description = <dl>.

density.description: compact: 32 px row height (operator). regular: 44 px row height (touch floor). comfortable: 56 px row height (mobile primary).

divider.description: Between-row divider. inset variant aligns under text in avatar-prefixed rows (iOS HIG).

border.description: card wraps the list in a Card surface (border + radius + raised bg).

keyboard: Tab - move focus into the list (interactive variant)
ArrowDown / ArrowUp - move focus between rows (interactive variant)
rules: Always render the semantic <ul>/<ol>/<dl> at the root — never role='list' on a div.
Interactive lists use roving tabindex (only the active row is tabbable).
Each ListItem in interactive mode has role='button' or renders <a>.
Touch target ≥ 44 px on interactive rows (use density='regular' or higher on mobile).

do: Use plain variant for prose bullets ('What's included:').
Use structured variant for settings / property lists with leading icon + label + trailing value.
Use interactive variant for navigable rows (account list, member list, file list).
Use density='compact' only on dense operator tables / sidebars.
Use divider='inset' when rows have leading Avatars / icons — the divider aligns under the text.
dont: Don't render lists with role='list' on a div. The semantic element ships SR support for free.
Don't combine plain variant with leading icons — that's structured.
Don't paint selected rows in lime fill. Use action.selected.bg.
Don't put two interactive elements on one row without making the row itself non-interactive (parent button + nested button breaks SR).

changelog.note: Initial List contract. Three variants (plain / structured / interactive), three densities, four divider modes.
